title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission Reports on Kosovo
part_text: Reiterates its firm belief that Kosovo’s future lies in the EU and that all efforts to bring Kosovo out of the ‘grey zone’ are in the interest of the people of both Kosovo and the EU, especially in the context of the current geopolitical dynamics in the region, rapid major shifts in world politicsandgrowing competition with authoritarian regimes;
